# twinnel helper install --dry-run: nothing below has been run.
1. install -d -m 0755 '/Library/Application Support/twinnel'
2. install -m 0755 /Applications/Twinnel.app/Contents/Resources/bin/twinnel-helper '/Library/Application Support/twinnel/bin/twinnel-helper'
3. install -d -m 0755 '/Library/Application Support/twinnel/logs'
4. launchctl bootout system/com.l3ony2k.twinnel.helper
5. wait until `launchctl print system/com.l3ony2k.twinnel.helper` says "not loaded" (up to 10s)
6. write /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.l3ony2k.twinnel.helper.plist (mode 0644, 812 bytes)
----- /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.l3ony2k.twinnel.helper.plist -----
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>Label</key>
	<string>com.l3ony2k.twinnel.helper</string>
	<key>ProgramArguments</key>
	<array>
		<string>/Library/Application Support/twinnel/bin/twinnel-helper</string>
	</array>
	<key>RunAtLoad</key>
	<true/>
	<key>KeepAlive</key>
	<true/>
</dict>
</plist>
----- end -----
7. launchctl enable system/com.l3ony2k.twinnel.helper
8. launchctl bootstrap system /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.l3ony2k.twinnel.helper.plist  # retried up to 3 times while busy
